entries.3b6cc3132a591eed: Its management philosophy is “Contribute widely to society through the use of high-energy substances and pursue the enrichment of employees in both material and mental terms,” and it states that it will prioritize safety and reliability, provide quality products, and actively promote the development of new products and the opening of new markets. As its main issues to address, it cites promoting the active role of its personnel; expanding the scope of its business, which covers the manufacture and sale of solid and liquid high-energy substances through to combustion disposal and evaluation testing (including expansion into the aerospace field and joint research and product development through industry-academia-government collaboration); and improving the profitability of existing products under high-mix, low-volume production (thorough QCD management, expansion of production capacity and improvement of productivity).

entries.68a571c508b15f04: A business that manufactures pyrotechnic products and sells most of them to external customers. It handles pyrotechnic products for defense equipment, safety products such as emergency safety flares and smoke flares for automobiles, and propellants, and also undertakes combustion disposal and evaluation testing of pyrotechnic products on a contract basis. The company mainly supplies raw materials to its affiliate, Hosoya Enterprise Co., Ltd., places outsourced processing orders with it, and purchases semi-finished products from it. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,959 million.
entries.7465d247b5980c16: The company has its head office and factory in Akiruno City, Tokyo, and manufactures and sells pyrotechnic products and leases facilities. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and it has 1 affiliate, Hosoya Enterprise Co., Ltd. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 94. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.78d32e3c24f10568: HOSOYA PYRO-ENGINEERING CO., LTD. is a pyrotechnic products manufacturer with its head office and plant in Akiruno, Tokyo. It was founded in 1906 manufacturing and selling fireworks, and its number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 94. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.7a2901790261c0fb: A business that leases large commercial store facilities, a large experimental building and explosives storehouses. Part of the explosives storehouses is leased to the affiliate Hosoya Enterprise Co., Ltd. It plans to build a new first-class explosives storehouse (construction to start in August 2026 and to be completed in September 2027). Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥177 million.

entries.a57d89f7ed62d88a: The pyrotechnic products the company handles are said to serve a special market with limited users. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, as demand for defense equipment in general rose in the defense field, order volumes for some products increased, and demand for the disposal of pyrotechnic products rose regardless of whether public or private, which also increased commissioned combustion disposal work, resulting in higher revenue. By customer, the Ministry of Defense accounted for 51.0% of total sales, and MINEBEA MITSUMI Inc. for 13.8%.
entries.aa072cd2d5ccd2f4: Its strength lies in having accumulated manufacturing technology for high-energy substances since its founding in 1906, ranging from fireworks to industrial and defense pyrotechnic products. It can handle everything from the manufacture and sale of solid and liquid high-energy substances to combustion disposal and evaluation testing, and it also continues research and development on ammonium dinitramide (ADN), for which there are almost no synthesis records in Japan, and hydroxylammonium nitrate (HAN), a base material for low-toxicity green propellants.
